trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions taken:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy across all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. Deployment history showed the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled all production regions back to v2.3.0. Verified afterwards — the service is now healthy in all regions with the error rate down to 0.2%.

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks; rolled back to v2.3.0") describing the diagnosis and rollback, which paged the on-call engineer. Root cause of the v2.3.1 failure is still under investigation.
